title: Operator: badge distinguishing authenticated vs anon turns

investigation.trigger: standing instruction to keep shipping real, tested improvements to the Command Hub Operator Console
investigation.target: services/gateway/src/routes/operator.ts::runOperatorChatTurn() reply meta + Command Hub app.js renderOperatorChat()
investigation.finding: callerIdentity/geminiUserRole were already resolved from the real JWT for dev_* tool gating but never surfaced on the reply, so an authenticated admin turn and an anonymous turn looked identical in the console

fix.new_field: response.meta.authenticated (boolean), derived from the existing geminiUserRole === 'admin' check
fix.mechanism: display-only; shared by /chat and /chat/stream via the common runOperatorChatTurn(); never trusts the client-supplied x-operator-role header; touches no authorization decision

live_verification: not performed — no deployed staging build carries this unmerged change; the change is a small additive badge with no layout restructuring, verified at the source level per this repo's established pattern for this class of change
